description: This file declares API functions for managing WAN interfaces, including starting, stopping, activating, and deactivating WAN interfaces within the WAN manager module.

methods.name: WanMgr_StartWanVISM
methods.description: Starts the interface state machine to obtain a WAN lease on all virtual interfaces configured for the specified interface.

methods.name: WanMgr_StopWanVISM
methods.description: Stops the WAN interface state machine and sets the selection status to not selected.

methods.name: WanMgr_ActivateInterface
methods.description: Activates the specified WAN interface by configuring routing, firewall, DNS, and MAP-T settings, transitioning it to active state.

methods.name: WanMgr_DeactivateInterface
methods.description: Deactivates the specified WAN interface, removing its configurations and transitioning it back to standby.
